#### 1. retinitis pigmentosa 73  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.780)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2024096, Reactome:R-HSA-2206291, Reactome:R-HSA-6798695)

Loss-of-function mutations in HGSNAT disrupt the lysosomal degradation of heparan sulfate. Impaired degradation leads to the accumulation of partially degraded glycosaminoglycans, which contributes to neurodegeneration in MPS III C and retinal degeneration in RP73.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of a pathogenic variant in HGSNAT that leads to a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect, or a pathogenic variant in a gene other than HGSNAT that is definitively shown to be the sole cause of either disease. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of HGSNAT in lysosomal degradation may reveal common therapeutic targets for both neurodegenerative and retinal degenerative conditions, potentially through enzyme replacement therapy or substrate reduction therapy.
